title: SkeleSketch: Microglial Morphology Analysis Tool
description: Developed an open-source Fiji/ImageJ tool using Java to automate microglial skeletonization and quantify cellular morphology, supporting research into microglial changes associated with ALS.

title: DNA FISH (Research Internship)
description: Tested and refined experimental procedures to establish a reliable DNA fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) protocol for C9orf72 research, alongside experience in microscopy, cell culture, and Western blotting.

title: NIH All of Us Data Analysis
description: Utilized the NIH All of Us Research Program dataset to analyze the relationship between socioeconomic facotrs and the likelihood of conditions such as age related macular degeneration (AMD) and Type 2 diabetes (T2D).

title: Predicting Super Bowl LVIII Teams
description: Used web scraping to collect NFL data from 2002 to 2023 and utilized a random forest model to predict which teams would reach Super Bowl LVIII.

title: Analyzing Social Media Usage and Addiction Patterns
description: Analyzed behavioral and emotional social media usage data using Python, clustering, statistical hypothesis testing, and decision trees to identify distinct user engagement patterns. Engineered behavioral metrics to uncover relationships between app-switching habits, usage intensity, and emotional states, highlighting the limitations of screen time alone as an indicator of problematic usage.

title: NBA Draft Efficiency: Player Performance and Team Success
description: Analyzed web scraped NBA draft data from 1989–2025 using correlation analysis and statistical comparisons to evaluate how draft position predicts player performance and whether drafting efficiency translates to team playoff success.

title: Blue Side Advantage in Professional League of Legends
description: Analyzed 2022 professional League of Legends matches to evaluate blue-side win-rate advantage and predict match outcomes using early-game statistics. Applied statistical testing, feature engineering, and Random Forest optimization to achieve 66.68% prediction accuracy while evaluating model fairness across teams' starting sides.

title: FPRO-Class Price Premium Across Retailers
description: Analyzed Food Processing classification and product pricing across Walmart, Target, and Whole Foods to compare prices and quantify the associated price premium, using data visualization to communicate differences in pricing across stores.

title: Persuasive Visualization of Global Reliance on Renewable Energy
description: Created persuasive and deceptive data visualizations exploring the global shift toward renewable energy, demonstrating how visualization choices can influence interpretation and shape the audience's perception of energy trends as well as how to argue two different sides despite using the same dataset.
